note: Set B reads the plotted marker positions more faithfully, giving distinct x2 coordinates (NA 0.0, SC 0.1, GC -0.1, CG -0.2 m) and the elevated x3 of GC (0.05 m) that the figure shows, while Set A flattens every x3 to 0.0 m and omits all x2 coordinates, losing most of the figure's engineering content. Set B's only clear slip is SC x3 = 0.05 m, since the shear-center marker sits at about the same height as NA (≈0.0 m), below the CG/GC markers. Both sets capture the five visible layup materials and the 70% span section, but both drop Carbon UD from the legend and support numeric coordinates only with legend labels.
remarks: All coordinate values must be read off a small scatter plot with no tabulated numbers, so 0.0 vs 0.05 m distinctions are near the resolution limit; SC x3 in B and the CG/GC x3 = 0.0 in A are judged from marker heights relative to the x3 = 0 tick. Both sets omit the Carbon UD material shown in the legend, and B omits CG x3 while A omits every x2 coordinate. Quotes for the coordinate claims are legend labels (e.g. 'NA: Neutral Axes') and support the entity/attribute but not the numeric values, in both sets.
